title: Code and data for: Are neural-network free-energy error bars calibrated? Tests on exact models and on alanine dipeptide in vacuum and explicit water
description:
Code, simulation data and results for a calibration study of uncertainty estimates for free-energy surfaces learned from mean forces. Neural-network ensembles (random initialization, bootstrap, noise injection, with and without held-out-label rescaling) and a gradient-observation Gaussian process are tested against known truth on a 2D and a 4D model with exact free energies and on alanine dipeptide in vacuum and in explicit TIP3P water (OpenMM), each referenced to four independent well-tempered metadynamics runs.

Includes all source code, the metadynamics reference free-energy surfaces, per-replica raw results and summaries for every experiment, run logs, and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table of the manuscript.

Version 1.1.0 adds alanine dipeptide in explicit water: the equilibrated water box, four 50 ns metadynamics reference runs, the calibration results (5 replicas per regime), GPU/resume support in the OpenMM scripts and a leading-order estimator-bias script.
